justification: We're running the same card we believe in. Daniel Jones took some hits last week and threw a couple he'd want back, but he stood in there, moved the ball, found the end zone, and showed up to work all week after - that earns him one more start over Cousins on the bench, matchup or no matchup. Mark Andrews only gave us 0.9 last Sunday, and I know what the sheet says about that, but the kid competed and he gets his one more week to respond, same as always - that's the deal in this program. Puka's Questionable, but he's telling us he's good to go and he's practiced all week, so we trust his word over a tag. Corum's riding momentum after finding the end zone, Dowdle, Wan'Dale, Amon-Ra, McPherson, and the Houston defense all did their jobs and keep their spots. Clear eyes, full hearts - we're 0-6, not 0 belief.
forum_post: Folks are speculating about what we're saving the $68 for. We're not saving it for a headline - we're saving it for the right fit, and we'll know it when we see it. Clear eyes, full hearts.
